mapper.select: SELECT INTERVIEW_NO, PROCESS_NO, USER_ID, INTERVIEW_DATE, INTERVIEW_LOCATION, INTERVIEW_TYPE, INTERVIEW_PASS_SCORE FROM INTERVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO , INTERVIEW_NO , COM_ID , JOB_CODE , INTERVIEW_DATE , TO_CHAR(INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') , USER_ID FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW

SELECT r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, r.INTERVIEW_NO, r.COM_ID, r.JOB_CODE, r.INTERVIEW_DATE, r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, i.INTERVIEW_INFORMATION_NO, i.EVALUATION, i.INTERVIEW_LEVEL, i.INTERVIEW_TYPE, i.INTERVIEW_CONTENT, p.PASS_INFORMATION_NO, p.INTERVIEW_QUESTION, p.TIP, p.INTERVIEW_PASS_YN FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW r LEFT JOIN INTERVIEW_INFORMATION i ON r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = i.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN PASS_INFORMATION p ON r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = p.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO WHERE r.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = #{interviewReviewNo}

SELECT INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, INTERVIEW_DATE, TO_CHAR(INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), USER_ID FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE DESC

SELECT INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, INTERVIEW_NO, COM_ID, JOB_CODE, INTERVIEW_DATE, TO_CHAR(INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'), USER_ID FROM INTERVIEW_REVIEW WHERE COM_ID = #{comId} ORDER BY INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE DESC

SELECT IR.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO AS INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO, IR.INTERVIEW_NO AS INTERVIEW_NO, IR.COM_ID AS COM_ID, IR.JOB_CODE AS JOB_CODE, IR.INTERVIEW_DATE AS INTERVIEW_DATE, TO_CHAR(IR.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE,
II.INTERVIEW_INFORMATION_NO AS INTERVIEW_INFORMATION_NO, II.EVALUATION AS EVALUATION, II.INTERVIEW_LEVEL AS INTERVIEW_LEVEL, II.INTERVIEW_TYPE AS INTERVIEW_TYPE, II.INTERVIEW_CONTENT AS INTERVIEW_CONTENT,
PI.PASS_INFORMATION_NO AS PASS_INFORMATION_NO, PI.INTERVIEW_QUESTION AS INTERVIEW_QUESTION , PI.TIP AS TIP, PI.INTERVIEW_PASS_YN AS INTERVIEW_PASS_YN,
RN.RECRUITMENT_NO AS RECRUITMENT_NO, RN.RECRUITMENT_TITLE AS RECRUITMENT_TITLE, RN.JOB_CODE AS JOB_CODE, RN.YEAR_CODE AS YEAR_CODE,
C.COM_NAME
FROM TEAM1_202501F.INTERVIEW_REVIEW IR JOIN TEAM1_202501F.INTERVIEW_INFORMATION II ON IR.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = II.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO LEFT JOIN TEAM1_202501F.PASS_INFORMATION PI ON IR.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO = PI.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.INTERVIEW I ON IR.INTERVIEW_NO = I.INTERVIEW_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUIT_PROCESS RP ON I.PROCESS_NO = RP.RECRUIT_PROCESS_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.RECRUITMENT_NOTICE RN ON RP.RECRUITMENT_NO = RN.RECRUITMENT_NO JOIN TEAM1_202501F.COMPANY C ON RN.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE IR.STATUS IS NULL ORDER BY IR.INTERVIEW_REVIEW_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE INTERVIEW_REVIEW SET STATUS = 'Y' WHERE COMPANY_REVIEW_NO = #{interviewReviewNo}
